submitted.rationale: EQE falls steadily as Sb increases from the Fe-rich end: 0.060% at Sb 0.12 (index 0), 0.044% at 0.21, 0.0095% at 0.31, about 0% at 0.49, and 0.019% at 0.77. The most Fe-rich composition, closest to Fe2O3, which absorbs 2.1 eV light, gave the highest measured EQE. XRD patterns at indices 0, 3 and 7 are almost identical and look like rutile, possibly mostly from the FTO substrate, so they could not tell the phases apart.
